own_model.name: gemma-3-270m SabiYarn-MT (vLLM)
own_model.anchor: MEASURED 5,347 tok/s with 4 sequences of b1024 on a card at 100% load from another job (reports/gemma_rl_vllm_2026-10-17.md); 5-10k tok/s sustained there. ASSUMPTION for a dedicated 96 GB card with 256-512 concurrent sequences: 10-40k tok/s.

africomet_ref.anchor: MEASURED on the RTX 5070 (AfriCOMET-QE fp16, 87.5 AfroXLM tokens per (src, mt) pair): 290-350 pairs/s single process, 480 pairs/s with three (reports/gemma_rl_cost_estimate_2026-10-17.md)
africomet_ref.assumption: x1.5-3 vs the RTX 5070 and x1.5 encoder tokens for the extra reference segment

reward_qe.cpu_note: GlotLID, chunk planning, consensus (group mode) and the shaping run on the CPU: about 1 core-second per document (assumption)
